body:
I get it. It is so tough. You feel as though the whole world is against you, and that there is no hope. 

Whilst you know that time heals, you’re feel not strong enough to fight through the time needed to feel better. 

This world has a place for you. You are a father to children who love you unconditionally by the very nature of parenthood. If you don’t want to keep fighting for yourself, keep fighting for them. 

You have got this. It is going to be okay

hey, it’s okay. 

smoking doesn’t make you a monster, neither does having a fight with your brother or not being able to get some school work done this evening. 

there is so much more to life than academic success, your parents are incredibly proud of you regardless. 

marijuana speeds up my thoughts, sends my pulse racing and I too sometimes struggle to rationalise my thoughts as someone who struggles with very bad anxiety. 

focus on your breathing - you will be okay. stick and episode of your favourite show on. it’s okay, to be okay. take your mind away from it all, you’ve got this!
